changelog:
v3.5.9 — Device-Aware Playback Routing

• New: Unified device tier detection classifies Fire TV Sticks into HIGH/MID/LOW/ULTRA_LOW tiers based on chipset + RAM.
• New: HEVC Main 10 (HDR) streams on LOW/ULTRA_LOW devices now show a friendly error instead of attempting an unwatchable slideshow or triggering a native crash.
• New: Diagnostic events logged at playback start for device capability telemetry.
• Changed: Resolution cap for budget devices raised from 720p to 1080p — plain 1080p AVC works on mt8695.
